items.originalTitle: Red Bull reveals striking white F1 race suits for US GP as fans call for matching livery
detailZh: 红牛车队在美国大奖赛上展示了引人注目的白色一级方程式赛车服，粉丝呼吁匹配的涂装
红牛车队公布了为美国大奖赛特别定制的白色赛车服
对于红牛车队的粉丝来说，关注红牛车队，了解一级方程式新闻、车手更新、技术洞察和米尔顿凯恩斯的分析与赛事分析。
红牛车队在奥斯汀即将举行的一级方程式美国大奖赛上揭幕了全部白色的赛车服，暗示可能为美洲赛车场的赛事引入匹配的一次性涂装。
四次冠军得主马克斯·维斯塔潘和他的队友伊萨克·哈迪亚在社交媒体上分享了一段展示新赛车服的视频。白色设计配有醒目的蓝色装饰和复古风格的缝制合作伙伴徽章。
新的赛车服让粉丝呼吁匹配的车队涂装。一位粉丝评论道：“现在白色公牛？！？！请吗？？！！”，另一位补充说：“现在用这个做一个类似的涂装。”
“有特别的涂装吗？”有人发帖询问，另一条评论写道：“刚刚想起今年我们还没有小红牛 22的特别涂装……COTA有什么计划？”
其他反应包括：“哦我的，请让赛车是白色的！”和“VCARB的赛车服也是白色的；我如何在赛道上找到这些人？”
美国大奖赛定于10月23日至25日举行，这将紧随维斯塔潘连续两次大奖赛胜利之后。他在新加坡大奖赛周末表现出色，赢得了冲刺赛的杆位，并最终夺冠，同时还赢得了大奖赛的杆位，这也是他职业生涯中第一次赢得大奖赛的杆位。
尽管红牛车队近期战绩出色，但目前他们在车队积分榜上排名第四，积分为332分。梅赛德斯车队以578分领先，法拉利车队以444分排名第二，麦凯轮车队以339分排名第三。
维斯塔潘在车手积分榜上排名第四，积分为221分，落后积分榜领跑者基米·安东内利119分。梅赛德斯车队的乔治·拉塞尔排名第二，法拉利车队的刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第三。哈迪尔因手腕受伤缺席了三次大奖赛周末，目前排名第八，积分为97分。
detailEn: Red Bull reveals striking white F1 race suits for US GP as fans call for matching livery
Red Bull has unveiled special white race suits for the United States Grand Prix
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.

Red Bull has unveiled all-white race suits for the upcoming Formula 1 United States Grand Prix in Austin, hinting that a matching one-off livery could also be introduced for the race at the Circuit of the Americas.

Four-time champion Max Verstappen and his team-mate Isack Hadjar showed off the new race suits in a video shared on the team's social media platforms. The white design features bold blue accents and vintage-style sewn-on partner badges.
The new race suits have left fans calling for a matching livery. "WHITE BULL NOW?!?! PLEASE??!?!!" one fan commented, while another added: "Now do a similar livery with this."
"There's a special livery, right?" someone else posted, and another comment read: "Just remembered we've not had a special livery of the RB 22 this year... anything cooking in COTA?"
Further reactions included: "Oh my, please let the car be white!" and "VCARB's suits are white as well; how am I gonna find these guys on the track?"

The United States Grand Prix, scheduled for 23-25 October, will follow back-to-back grand prix wins for Verstappen. He dominated the Singapore Grand Prix weekend, claiming pole position for the sprint race, which he won, and pole position for the grand prix, which he went on to win for the first time in his career.

Despite its recent run of wins, Red Bull currently sits fourth in the constructors' championship with 332 points. Mercedes leads with 578 points, and Ferrari and McLaren follow in second and third with 444 and 339 points, respectively.

Verstappen is fourth in the drivers' standings with 221 points, 119 points behind championship leader Kimi Antonelli. Mercedes' George Russell is second and Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton is third. Hadjar is eighth with 97 points, having missed three grand prix weekends due to a wrist injury.

items.originalTitle: McLaren’s Oscar Piastri conquers the dirt in F1 and MotoGP crossover
detailZh: 麦凯伦车手奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂里在F1和MotoGP的跨界越野赛事中征服越野赛道
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂里在Quad Lock的Young Guns 2活动中与MotoGP的佩德罗·阿科斯塔展开了一场史诗般的越野赛车对决
赛车文化超越赛道，涉及车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计以及那些让赛车运动不仅仅是一项运动的故事
我们知道现代F1车手都讨厌输，无论是摩纳哥大奖赛、他们在模拟器上的F1比赛，还是与MotoGP骑手的越野赛车比赛，他们都会全力以赴
当Quad Lock决定让麦凯轮车手奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂和MotoGP sensation佩德罗·阿科斯塔在《Young Guns Part 2》中重聚时，那种竞争的势头表现得淋漓尽致。他们把价值数百万美元的赛车换成相同的Segway超级反派越野车，这两位全球赛车运动明星在法国里维埃拉的Monti MX赛道上，为了解决他们2024年第一次卡丁车挑战赛中的恩怨而展开对决。
皮亚斯蒂在自己的主场沥青赛道上主导了最初的卡丁车挑战赛，但在Monti MX的土质赛道上，他面临的是完全不同的挑战。这里有巨大的跳跃、深深的凹槽和滑溜的弯道，你可能会认为阿科斯塔——一个以驾驶300马力摩托车为生的人——会有明显的优势。
阿科斯塔显然对越野车上的安全特性比他通常使用的两轮火箭船感到更加舒适。
“我感觉太安全了。就像，如果我翻车，我不会头朝地撞到地上，你知道吗？”这位MotoGP明星开玩笑说，并指出四点安全带和防滚架比皮夹克和安全帽有了巨大的提升。
皮亚斯特里，另一方面，他只是很高兴自己不必平衡车辆。
“我觉得它还能保持四轮行驶对我来说是好事。实际上它在泥土上，而我从未在泥土上开过车……这对我来说不是什么好事，”皮亚斯特里在比赛前承认道。
由冒险骑手和电视主持人Charley Boorman主持的比赛包括短距离冲刺、速度陷阱和最后的两圈大奖赛。
皮亚斯特里很快证明了他是一个快速学习者，赢得了短距离冲刺和速度陷阱的挑战。但真正的戏剧性事件发生在最后的Grand Prix赛事中，Acosta在试图追回地盘时用力过猛。
“我在第一个发夹弯处犯了一个错误，然后我只是在尝试弥补我失去的时间，我差点就把自己送上了绝路，”阿科斯塔笑着回忆起一次恐怖的高速跳跃。'我真的很接近让赛车翻转到前面。“'
皮亚斯特里展现出了那种赢得九场F1大奖赛胜利的冷静、流畅的驾驶风格，他完美地保持了冷静。他以1分53秒的成绩冲过终点线，击败了阿科斯塔的1分54秒的疯狂表现，赢得了整体年轻枪手的冠军。“
接下来是什么？
随着皮亚斯特里获得胜利，自然而然的问题是，这两位明星如何在潜在的年轻枪手第三部分中解决平局。“
阿科斯塔渴望使比赛场地公平，他建议最简单获胜的方式是在下次比赛时让他们两人都骑上两轮摩托车。但皮亚斯特里立即打消了看到他骑 dirt bike 的任何希望。
"如果我们这么做，我认为麦凯轮可能不会那么高兴，" 阿科斯塔开玩笑说，皮亚斯特里微笑着补充道，"不，我不这么认为，" 他更愿意保持自己的赛车合同完整。"我仍然开放接受四轮挑战，但我们必须继续做《年轻枪手3》来尝试看看我是否能赢得一些东西，" 阿科斯塔总结道。
目前，比分已经确定。如果你想看到一名MotoGP车手在几乎翻车之前，在并排的越野车中能抓到多少空气，你可以在Quad Lock的YouTube频道上观看《年轻枪手2》的全场对决。
detailEn: McLaren’s Oscar Piastri conquers the dirt in F1 and MotoGP crossover
Oscar Piastri takes on MotoGP’s Pedro Acosta in an epic dirt buggy showdown for Quad Lock's Young Guns 2
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

If there's one thing we know about modern Formula 1 drivers, it's that they hate losing. It doesn't matter if it's the Monaco Grand Prix, a round of F1 on their sim rigs, or a dirt buggy race against a MotoGP rider - they are going to absolutely send it.

That competitive streak was on full display when Quad Lock decided to reunite McLaren's Oscar Piastri and MotoGP sensation Pedro Acosta for Young Guns Part 2. Trading in their multi-million-dollar race machines for identical Segway Super Villain off-road buggies, the two global motorsport stars hit the Monti MX track on the French Riviera to settle a score from their first go-karting challenge back in 2024.

While Piastri dominated the original karting challenge on his home turf of asphalt, the dirt track at Monti MX presented a totally different beast. With massive jumps, deep ruts, and slippery corners, you'd think Acosta - a guy who wrestles 300-horsepower motorcycles for a living - would have a clear advantage.
Acosta certainly felt more comfortable with the buggies' safety features compared to his usual two-wheeled rocket ships.

"I feel too safe. Like, if I flip, I will not hit my head with the ground, you know?" the MotoGP star joked, noting that a four-point harness and a rollcage is a massive upgrade from a leather suit and a helmet.
Piastri, on the other hand, was just glad he didn't have to balance the vehicle.
"I feel like the fact it's still on four wheels is good for me. Fact it's on dirt, and that I've never driven on dirt... that's not in my thing," Piastri admitted before the race.
Hosted by adventure rider and TV presenter Charley Boorman, the competition consisted of a sprint, a speed trap, and a final two-lap Grand Prix.

Piastri quickly proved that he’s a fast learner, taking both the sprint race and the speed trap challenges. But the real drama unfolded during the final Grand Prix event, where Acosta pushed a little too hard trying to make up ground.

"I make a mistake going down to the first hairpin, and then I was just trying to recover the time that I lost, and I was close enough to kill myself," Acosta laughed, recounting a terrifying, high-speed launch off a jump. "I was really close to flip the car to the front".

Piastri, displaying the ice-cold, smooth driving style that has earned him nine F1 Grand Prix wins, stayed perfectly calm. He crossed the line with a 1:53 lap time, beating Acosta’s wild 1:54 run to claim the overall Young Guns crown.
What's next?
With Piastri taking the win, the natural question is how the two stars will settle the tiebreaker in a potential Young Guns Part 3.
Acosta, eager to level the playing field, suggested the easiest way to win is to put them both on two wheels next time. But Piastri immediately shut down any hopes of seeing him on a dirt bike.

"I think McLaren will not be so happy if we go for it," Acosta joked, with Piastri adding, "No, I don't think so," with a smile, preferring to keep his racing contract intact. "I still open for four-wheel challenge, but we'll have to keep doing Young Guns Part 3 to try if I see if I win something," Acosta concluded.

For now, the score is settled. If you want to see exactly how much air a MotoGP rider can catch in a side-by-side buggy before nearly rolling it, you can catch the full Young Guns 2 showdown on Quad Lock's YouTube channel.

items.originalTitle: George Russell targets US race for looming Mercedes engine grid penalty
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔瞄准美国站应对即将到来的梅赛德斯引擎网格处罚
乔治·拉塞尔确认另一场引擎网格处罚即将到来，但梅赛德斯计划在拉斯维加斯承担损失。
对于梅赛德斯车迷来说，这里是关于银箭的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析，来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃斯。
在2026赛季的这个阶段，乔治·拉塞尔几乎与FIA裁判员成了朋友。在新加坡大奖赛中，由于更换了大量动力单元部件，他遭受了惊人的60位发车位置下降，你可能会认为这位英国车手会尽可能地远离发车区末尾。
再想想吧。
梅赛德斯正在准备在年底前再安装一个升级的动力单元部件，这意味着拉塞尔不得不吞下苦果，并接受又一次的排位下降。但这一次，布拉克利车队不会随便承受打击。他们正故意等待拉斯维加斯大道的霓虹灯亮起时才采取行动。
在接受天空体育F1采访时，拉塞尔确认，虽然另一个与引擎相关的处罚不可避免，但梅赛德斯已经赢得了战术上的喘息空间来选择他们的战场。
“说实话，现在可能是在赛季的后期，也许是在拉斯维加斯。但它在某个时候会出现，”拉塞尔解释说。“现在我们可以选择何时接受它，我们将选择稍微容易一些的赛道[来超越]。”
这里的逻辑很难被反驳。在一个狭窄、技术性强的赛道上受到引擎处罚，本质上就是报名参加一场长达两小时的游行，被困在中游DRS车队后面。新加坡已经用这种方式让梅赛德斯学到了这个教训；尽管拉塞尔的车速比他前面的车快近1.5秒一圈，但污染的气流尾流整晚都困住了他，限制了他的恢复速度，最终排名第九。
另一方面，拉斯维加斯基本上是一条直线赛道，有几个90度的弯道和一个球体。在1.9公里的全速直道上，搭载新鲜动力和DRS的梅赛德斯应该能够毫无困难地穿越车队。
即将到来的升级是梅赛德斯在赛季末积极开发的一部分。在新加坡进行了分设配置后——在那里，赛道工程总监安德鲁·肖夫林确认基米·安东内利的升级版W17“显然比另一个更快”——车队希望确保两位车手在最后一段都有最锋利的工具。
安东内利有足够的奢侈来捍卫他的102分冠军领先优势，并在奥斯汀追逐可能的冠军加冕，而拉塞尔则一直在做不引人注目的脏活，测试硬件，更换部件，并在维修区处罚中挣扎。
通过将即将到来的动力单元处罚推迟到拉斯维加斯，梅赛德斯避免了在奥斯汀、墨西哥城和英特拉戈斯这些赛道上浪费积分——在这些赛道上，赛道位置至关重要，超车更加困难。
如果拉塞尔在赛季结束前还要从最后一排发车一次，那么在拉斯维加斯的灯光下，带着一台全新的引擎进行比赛可能会给粉丝带来今年最精彩的时刻。
detailEn: George Russell targets US race for looming Mercedes engine grid penalty
George Russell confirms another engine grid penalty is coming, but Mercedes plans to take the hit in Las Vegas
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

At this point in the 2026 season, George Russell is practically on a first-name basis with the FIA stewards. After eating a staggering 60-place grid drop at the Singapore Grand Prix to replace an entire pharmacy of power unit components, you would think the British driver would want to stay as far away from the back of the grid as humanly possible.
Think again.

Mercedes is preparing to bolt on another upgraded power unit element before the year wraps up, meaning Russell will have to take his medicine and accept yet another grid drop. But this time around, the Brackley squad isn't just going to take the hit anywhere. They are deliberately waiting for the neon lights of the Las Vegas Strip to pull the trigger.
Speaking to Sky Sports F1, Russell confirmed that while another engine-related penalty is inevitable, Mercedes has earned the tactical breathing room to pick their battlefield.

"It will probably be later in the season now, to be honest — maybe Las Vegas. But it will be there at some point," Russell explained. "Now we have the choice to take it when we wish, and we will choose slightly easier tracks [to overtake at]."

The logic here is pretty hard to argue with. Taking an engine penalty at a tight, technical circuit is essentially signing up for a two-hour parade stuck behind a midfield DRS train. Singapore already taught Mercedes that lesson the hard way; despite Russell having nearly 1.5 seconds a lap in raw pace over the cars in front of him, the dirty air wake trapped him all night, capping his recovery drive at P9.

Las Vegas, on the other hand, is basically a drag strip with a couple of 90-degree corners and a sphere. With a massive 1.9-kilometer flat-out blast down the Strip, a Mercedes carrying fresh horsepower and DRS should have zero trouble carving through the pack.

The looming upgrade is part of Mercedes' aggressive late-season development push. After running split setups in Singapore—where Trackside Engineering Director Andrew Shovlin confirmed that Kimi Antonelli’s upgraded W17 was "clearly the faster of the two"—the team wants to ensure both drivers have the sharpest tools available for the final stretch.

While Antonelli has the luxury of defending his 102-point championship lead and chasing a potential title coronation in Austin, Russell has been doing the unglamorous dirty work of testing hardware, cycling through components, and battling through grid penalties.

By pushing the upcoming power unit penalty back to Vegas, Mercedes avoids throwing away points at Austin, Mexico City, and Interlagos—venues where track position is king and passing is far more difficult.

If Russell has to start from the back of the grid one more time before the season shuts down, doing it under the Las Vegas lights with a fresh engine might just give fans the most entertaining charge of the year.

items.originalTitle: Christian Horner admits that F1 rivalry with Toto Wolff became "theatre"
items.summaryEn: Christian Horner has admitted that his long-standing rivalry with Toto Wolff became "more like theatre", but insisted it was still "authentic".
detailZh: 克里斯蒂安·霍纳承认与托托·沃尔夫的F1竞争变成“戏剧”
这两位车队负责人在各自车队年复一年争夺F1冠军期间展开了激烈的竞争
托托·沃尔夫，梅赛德斯AMG车队负责人兼首席执行官，克里斯蒂安·霍纳，红牛车队负责人，在发车格上为奖杯掰手腕
克里斯蒂安·霍纳承认，他与F1同行托托·沃尔夫之间长期的竞争变得“更像戏剧”——但仍坚称那是“真实的”。
2010年至2023年间的每一个F1世界冠军，要么由沃尔夫执掌的梅赛德斯车队赢得，要么由霍纳领导的红牛车队夺得，这自然导致双方势同水火。
这一幕常常被Netflix热门纪录片《极速求生》记录下来，其中尤为典型的一幕是2022年地面效应新规实施之初，两人就海豚跳问题展开的激烈争论。
霍纳喜欢扮演“哑剧反派”的角色，但自从他在2025年7月被解雇后，这一切都平息了下来，因为接替他的洛朗·梅基斯是一个圆滑得多的人。
“摄像机刚出现时，一切都很真实，”霍纳告诉《赛车运动》。“然后你能感觉到，随着赛季推进，出现了相当多男性形象管理，变得更有戏剧性了一些。”
“但我始终觉得自己很真实，当然，这些人在拍一档电视节目，所以他们拍摄了成千上万小时的素材，关键在于你怎么剪辑。
“你可以把某人剪成反派或英雄，或者反过来。那档节目之所以极其成功，是因为它突然揭开了那些竞争、个性、车手的个性、一些人物性格的面纱。”
霍纳与沃尔夫之间的竞争在2021年达到顶峰，当时红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘与梅赛德斯车队的刘易斯·汉密尔顿为车手总冠军展开了激烈争夺。
在维斯塔潘追逐他的首个总冠军、汉密尔顿寻求创纪录的第八个总冠军的过程中，两人多次发生碰撞，而两支车队也在为车队总冠军展开较量。
这一切在充满争议的阿布扎比收官战中结束，维斯塔潘击败汉密尔顿，为红牛赢得了自2013年以来的首个车手总冠军，而梅赛德斯则连续第八次夺得车队总冠军。
“托托是一位强大的竞争对手，梅赛德斯是一支庞大的车队，”霍纳补充道。“他们曾经取得并享有的成功，正是这一点让2021年对我们更加重要。
“但他情绪化、好胜、有动力，我们享受这种竞争。我对他的所作所为和成就怀有极大的尊重，但我认为在所有体育运动中，你都需要有竞争。
“你们不可能一直只是最好的朋友，这不符合现实。当然，那是激励车队的一种方式——梅赛德斯就是对手。
“作为一家能量饮料公司的子公司，我们必须努力与他们抗衡，向他们发起挑战。”
2021年阿布扎比领奖台上的汉密尔顿和霍纳
霍纳坚持认为，F1需要像过去那些年一样，在领先集团中形成激烈的竞争对抗，无论是阿兰·普罗斯特对埃尔顿·塞纳，还是詹姆斯·亨特对尼基·劳达。
竞争对抗最终有助于售票和抢占头条，足球或板球同样如此，而在霍纳看来，这是车队追逐成功的自然结果。
“有竞争是好事，只要不越界变成针对个人，”他说，“这在体育中是健康的，无论你是拥有佩普·瓜迪奥拉和何塞·穆里尼奥，还是弗格森和温格。
“它能激发体育的活力，而且我认为在一支团队内部也是如此，如果你想赢，你就必须心中有团火。
“一级方程式是世界上最激烈、最艰难的运动之一，你要求人们去做非凡的事情，去达到会影响他们家庭生活和在家时间等等的极限，因为这相当缺乏社交。
“所以你在激励你的团队，这就是竞争，如果你能找到弱点，那么你就能看到它会渗透开来。”
detailEn: Christian Horner admits that F1 rivalry with Toto Wolff became "theatre"
The two team bosses had a heated rivalry while their squads fought for the F1 title year on year
Toto Wolff, Team Principal and CEO, Mercedes AMG, Christian Horner, Team Principal, Red Bull Racing, arm wrestle over the trophy on the grid
Christian Horner has accepted that his long-standing rivalry with Formula 1 counterpart Toto Wolff became ‘more like theatre’ - but still assured it was “authentic”.
Every F1 title between 2010 and 2023 was won by either Wolff’s Mercedes team or Horner’s Red Bull squad, which naturally caused them to be at loggerheads with each other.
This was often captured on Netflix hit Drive to Survive with one particular moment being their heated argument about porpoising at the start of the ground-effect regulations in 2022.
Horner liked to play the role of ‘pantomime villain’ but it’s all died down since his firing in July 2025, as replacement Laurent Mekies is a much more diplomatic individual.

“When the cameras first turned up it was very authentic,” Horner told Autosport. “Then you could feel as the seasons went on that there was considerably more male grooming and it became a little more theatre.
“But I always felt authentic to myself and, of course, these guys are making a TV show so they take hours and hours and hours of footage and it's all about how you edit something.

“You can either make somebody look like the villain or the hero or vice versa. That show has been incredibly successful because it suddenly lifted the lid on some of the rivalries, the personalities, the driver's personalities, some of the characters.”
The rivalry between Horner and Wolff reached its peak in 2021 when Red Bull’s Max Verstappen bitterly fought Mercedes’ Lewis Hamilton for the drivers’ title.
They collided on several occasions as Verstappen chased his maiden crown with Hamilton hunting for a record-breaking eighth, while the two teams also battled for the constructors’ title.
It ended in the contentious Abu Dhabi finale, where Verstappen dethroned Hamilton to give Red Bull its first drivers’ championship since 2013, while Mercedes took an eighth consecutive teams’ crown.
“Toto is a formidable competitor and Mercedes are a massive team,” added Horner. “The success that they've enjoyed and had, that's what made ‘21 even more important to us.
“But he's emotional, he's competitive, he's driven and we enjoyed a rivalry. I have huge respect for what he's done and achieved but I think in all sports you need to have rivalry.
“You can't all just be best friends all of the time, it's not true to the reality. Certainly that was a way of galvanising the team that Mercedes are the opposition.
“We have to try, as a subsidiary of an energy drinks company, to take them on and take the fight to them.”
Hamilton and Horner on the Abu Dhabi podium in 2021
Horner was insistent on F1 needing heated rivalries at the front as had happened in years gone by, whether it was Alain Prost versus Ayrton Senna or James Hunt versus Niki Lauda.
Rivalries ultimately play a part in selling tickets and grabbing headlines, likewise in football or cricket, and to Horner it is a natural consequence of teams chasing success.
“It's good to have rivalry, so long as it doesn't spill over into personal,” he said. “It's healthy in sport, whether you have Pep Guardiola and Jose Mourinho or Ferguson and Wenger.
“It galvanises sport and I think as well within a team, you've got to have a fire in your belly if you want to win.

“Formula 1 is one of the most competitive, hardest sports in the world and you're asking people to do extraordinary things and go to limits that have impact on their family lives and time at home and so on, because it is pretty unsociable.
“So you're galvanising your group that that is the competition and if you can find a weakness, then you can see that it permeates.”

两位车队负责人之间的激烈竞争在Netflix热门纪录片《Drive to Survive》中经常被呈现。
